title: Quick save, twelve save slots with pictures, and hearts in People
caption: The save conventions you agreed to. F5 quick saves and F9 quick loads on a computer; on the phone there is a save button in the top bar, and both are in the pause menu. Loading asks first only when you'd lose progress. Save and Load are one screen now, with the quick save, the autosave and twelve slots, each with a picture, the place, the day and period, the goal and the real time. People shows each bond as five hearts with a line on where you stand. A quick save in the middle of a conversation brings that conversation back from its first line, and the notice says so. Names on day 2 showing as ids (mio, guard) is an older bug, now issue #223.

sections.title: Quick save and quick load, desktop
sections.caption: Saved in the middle of Mio's first message on day 2, then F9: the conversation starts again from its first line. Then saved while free, a purchase and a new goal, F9: it asks, and Load brings back the same room, goal and money.

sections.title: The saves screen, desktop
sections.caption: Save and Load tabs; arrow keys move through the cards. Saving over a slot asks first.

sections.title: Phone
sections.caption: The save button sits left of the menu button. Its row fits 390 px with every chip up on the public build (the local note button wraps to a second row).

sections.title: People
sections.caption: Five hearts per person, filled to their bond step, and a line on where things stand. Only the step shows, never what the next one needs.
